title: Hearty Herbal Italian Ladyfingers Tiramisu
description: A satvik-friendly Italian dessert featuring red wine vinegar and ladyfingers, with a peppery and springy twist, perfect for festive occasions.
instructions: Start by brewing a cup of herbal tea and letting it cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled herbal tea, red wine vinegar, and ground peppercorns, stirring to combine.
Dip each ladyfinger into the tea mixture for about 3-5 seconds on each side, then set aside on a wire rack.
In a separate bowl, whip the mascarpone cheese until smooth, then add the confectioners sugar, egg yolks, and vanilla extract, whipping until stiff peaks form.
To assemble the tiramisu, start with a layer of ladyfingers, followed by a layer of the mascarpone mixture, and repeat until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of mascarpone on top.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle the top of the tiramisu with additional confectioners sugar and a few grindings of peppercorns.
Slice the tiramisu into individual servings and serve chilled.
